title: Children's Term and Accidental Death Benefit Riders on Term Life Insurance
content:
Two optional riders may be carried on any Term Life Insurance tier; their figures are the same on the Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term and on the Ashgrove Level Term 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30.

### Children's term rider

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Maximum units | 20 |
| Death benefit per unit | USD 1000 |
| Premium per unit per policy year (the product's children's term rate per unit) | USD 6.00 |

### Accidental death benefit rider

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Largest rider amount | USD 250000 |
| Premium per 1,000 of rider amount per policy year (the product's accidental death rider rate per 1,000) | USD 0.96 |
| Attained age at which the rider ends (the product's accidental death rider expiry age) | 70 |

Hypothetical illustration of the product rates: 4 children's units at 6.00 a unit come to 24.00 a year; an accidental death rider of 100000 at 0.96 per 1,000 comes to 96.00 a year.
